## Description
Briefly describe the changes made in this pull request and the rationale behind them.

## Validation evidence
List checks actually run and their results. Explain skipped checks. For UI changes, include screenshots using fictional data and check English/Nepali and light/dark mode where applicable.

## Review notes
Describe any configuration changes, migration steps, or known limitations. Remove this section if unnecessary.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Code refactoring / performance optimization
